::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 104,160 people lived in County Kilkenny, up 5.0% on 2016. It had the 16th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 51% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Kilkenny was €1,207, the 13th highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Kilkenny

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Kilkenny was €27,910, the 12th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Kilkenny was €349,100, the 7th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 5.0 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Kilkenny, the 13th highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 24% of households in County Kilkenny rented their home, the 19th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 14% of people living in County Kilkenny were born outside Ireland, the lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 43% of people aged 3 and over in County Kilkenny said they could speak Irish, the 7th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 30% of people at work in County Kilkenny worked from home for at least part of the week, the 9th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 77% of people travelling to work in County Kilkenny went by car, the 5th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Kilkenny live more than 2.7 km by road from a GP, the 10th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Kilkenny live more than 14.7 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 21st furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 10.2% of County Kilkenny in 2021, the 14th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
